status: exploratory appearance directions; transformation mechanics and triggers not specified

variants.name: 露光幼灵
variants.hook: 水滴般圆润的身体 → 一滴凝聚的柔光；亲近、初生。
variants.design:
NORMAL FORM: a soft compact pear-shaped torso and a rounded teardrop-shaped head whose ONE short tapered top leans gently sideways, two small dark blue-grey dot eyes, no mouth. Short rounded arms with little mitten hands and two clearly separated short feet. A little amber light seed sits in the chest, surrounded by one faint concentric watercolor tide mark. Simplify the whole body into a few generous rounded flat washes, no physical watery glass highlights or wet surface. Read as a luminous little living dew-drop, not a ghost in a sheet. One hand slightly outstretched.
PURE-LIGHT FORM at right: the body condenses into one softly pointed asymmetrical ivory-blue droplet of light, about one-third the main character's height, with the SAME gold seed and faint concentric wash ring inside. No head, arms, legs or face remain; a short taper gently indicates direction, not speed-lines or a wing. Very soft handwritten watercolor edge.
variants.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: original protagonist exploration illustration for a poetic 2D watercolor puzzle game in an abandoned garden.
Primary request: a LIGHT SPIRIT that normally has a little walkable, jumpable humanoid body with two usable arms/hands and two feet, but can under certain conditions transform into pure light. Show BOTH states of ONE SAME character in this image. This is an exploratory appearance design, not a description of specific transformation abilities or triggers.
Style/medium: clearly HAND-DRAWN, FLAT 2D WATERCOLOR STORYBOOK illustration. The artistic reference is Gorogoa's intimate ink-and-illustration visual language, transformed into translucent watercolor stains, visible textured paper, softly bleeding edges, fine deliberate pen contours, flat simplified color shapes and selective botanical ornament. The lighting reference is LIMBO's pale backlight, layered grey mist, dark foreground silhouettes and quiet solitude. Small warm light in a dark cool world. Prioritize charming illustrative shape design and negative space, NOT realistic materials or detailed 3D volume.
Composition: landscape 3:2 canvas. On the LEFT, one large fully visible normal-form character standing on a simple illustrated mossy garden ledge, about 65 percent image height; three-quarter view with all limbs legible. On the RIGHT, separated by generous blank fog, ONE smaller pure-light form of that exact same character, suspended in plain darker mist for appearance comparison, about 30 percent image height. The two states share one tiny pale-gold inner light seed and a recognizable silhouette motif. No arrows, dividing border or graphic UI, no text. A sparse painted ruined greenhouse outline in distant fog, a couple of flat silhouetted leaves near the frame; a quiet illustration, not a detailed scenic render. Both designs clearly visible at a glance.
Subject identity: an original small ethereal being made of condensed light, about three heads tall, curious and gentle, with an unforced childlike posture. Light itself forms its limbs. The face is extremely simple and restrained, no human skin, hair or clothing. Most body tone pale translucent blue-grey or ivory watercolor with a small warm gold core, NOT pure overexposed white; shadows within light help read structure. Keep normal form cohesive and grounded. In pure-light form the anatomy dissolves and the same gold seed remains recognizable.
Constraints: no human with a lamp; no candle, wick, rope, wax, glass oil lamp, lantern or metal casing; no angel wings, fairy wings, hovering halo, weapons or held objects; no resemblance to existing game characters. No 3D render, photorealism, realistic subsurface scattering, plastic toy, glossy glass shader, cinematic lens blur, elaborate material microtexture, neon rainbow bloom, giant anime eyes, hard horror, lettering, labels, logos, watermark or multiple alternate characters. Watercolor pigment and drawn shapes should remain evident even inside the light.

variants.name: 月弧游灵
variants.hook: 纤长月牙轮廓 → 一弯银白光弧；安静、空灵。
variants.design:
NORMAL FORM: a slender spirit whose HEAD is a thick soft asymmetrical crescent of milky light, seen mostly in silhouette; one curved outer contour and a small concave indentation on the right create a gentle moon profile, not animal ears or horns. Its face has only one tiny muted gold eyelike dash near the inner bend, not a pair of bright eyes. A narrow curved torso with two delicate arms, visible small three-pronged hands and two long tapered but clearly planted feet. The chest contains a tiny warm seed. Proportions graceful, about three-and-a-half heads tall, body edges slightly unfinished in watercolor. No round halo or full ring around the character.
PURE-LIGHT FORM at right: one freely suspended slim silver-white crescent arc, OPEN on one side, with the SAME warm gold seed nestled at its inner bend. No humanoid anatomy, no complete circular ring, no mask face. Match the normal head's curvature. A faint blue-grey watercolor shadow gives the white arc its readable form without 3D shading.

variants.name: 褶光行者
variants.hook: 垂落的光褶形成小人 → 三条舒展的光带；诗意、流动。
variants.design:
NORMAL FORM: an original little spirit made from THREE broad translucent strips of light folded loosely into a small person. A simple small softly pointed head is formed from the meeting of the strips, with two minimal dim blue-grey eye marks. Beneath the head the overlapping bands create a short triangular body silhouette like a folded luminous petal, but these are the body itself, NOT a fabric cloak or clothing. Two little ribbon-like forearms end in clearly usable hands; two short lower bands form separate legs and flat grounded feet. A pale golden seed is visible at the central intersection of the chest. Big clear areas of transparent ivory, dusty lavender and pale blue with visible ink contour and watercolor overlap. No physical fabric weave, no ornate fluttering scarf, no long train.
PURE-LIGHT FORM at right: the same THREE broad strips unfurl into an airy asymmetric S-shaped group of silver-gold light ribbons around the SAME tiny central gold seed. They remain three broad readable painted curves, NOT dozens of thin filaments. No body, face or limbs. Their crossing pattern recalls the normal character's chest folds. Keep the overall shape compact and quiet.

variants.name: 棱光精灵
variants.hook: 圆钝的不规则光面 → 错落相接的折光片；清晰、几何。
variants.design:
NORMAL FORM: a short compact spirit formed from about SEVEN large slightly irregular translucent geometric planes of light, with rounded or softened corners. A small asymmetrical pentagonal head, one shorter facet at a temple, two tiny muted dark eye dots; a trapezoidal torso with the same small warm gold seed at its center; two angular but friendly arms with distinct tiny hands and two stout stepped legs, feet grounded. The planes are flat watercolor polygons with thin hand-drawn blue-grey outlines and subtle overlapping tint, NOT a hard gemstone, physical glass sculpture, armor, robot or Minecraft block figure. Visually lightweight, softly imperfect and friendly. Very restrained hint of lavender and pale apricot refraction in two facets only, no rainbow decoration.
PURE-LIGHT FORM at right: the figure becomes a compact floating cluster of FIVE offset connected translucent light facets, like irregular patches of sunlight overlapping on paper. The SAME tiny gold seed sits at one junction. No head, arms or legs; facets echo the normal form's tilted pentagonal silhouette. Soft watercolor seams, a little light leaking at corners, not crystalline glass reflections or shards.

variants.name: 星尘微灵
variants.hook: 光尘聚成小人 → 围绕光核的星尘簇；神秘、梦境。
variants.design:
NORMAL FORM: a small cohesive person-shaped spirit with a rounded oblong head, a compact slightly hunched torso, two short but clear arms and mitten hands, two visible sturdy little legs and feet. The silhouette is formed from soft dark-to-pale watercolor light-mist, with a selectively drawn stippled edge of tiny gold and ivory specks. The center must be a continuous, clearly readable body, NOT a vague swarm or wire figure. One small warm gold seed in its chest is the brightest point; the face is just two tiny subdued pencil-like short marks, no mouth. One asymmetric tuft of five or six small light flecks drifts upward from the head, not ears, horns, antlers or a crown. Soft lost and found contours, much simpler than photoreal particle effects.
PURE-LIGHT FORM at right: one quiet compact ellipsoidal cloud of watercolor light specks gathered around the SAME central warm seed, brighter in the center and sparse at the edges. No distinct head or limbs. Three slightly larger flecks repeat the tiny tuft motif. No giant star shape, no fireworks, no dramatic comet trail or huge radiating explosion. Both states are intimate and delicate, like dust seen in a shaft of dawn light.
